text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature has managed to leave her
mark on
the Twinkle Series.

Together, we've successfully navigated
the crucial
first three years of her career.

One day, while still basking in the glory
of our
accomplishments...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Sorry for the wait.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
My hair is not holding together well...
despite the
hair oil I put in last night.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Huh. Okay.
choice_data_list: 大丈夫、いつも通りだよ

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Same as usual, huh? I guess I should be
glad.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I think I put a decent amount of effort
into my
appearance, but good to know
people can't tell
the difference.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whaaaat? Come on, Trainer.
choice_data_list: ……今日は少しふわっとしてる？

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You should keep comments like that to
yourself,
okay?

Nice Nature has come so far over the
past three
years. Perhaps it feels so
pronounced because she
can so
confidently express herself now.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well, why don't we start heading out?

Nice Nature and I head to the shopping
district
that she often hangs out at.
Apparently, there's a
festival going on
there.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's just a small community festival, so
don't
expect anything extravagant.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But everyone is really invested in this, so
it should
be pretty interesting—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh, Kimie!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper Lady
text_block_list.text: Hey, Natie! You came!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Of course! And it wouldn't be a party
without my
trainer here!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper Lady
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, are you turning our festival into a
date?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Come ooon, that joke's getting old.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper Lady
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to be shy! Well, I gotta
go help
with some things, so I'll see you
later!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Later!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Goodness gracious. Always teasing me
about it
being a date... What is she,
twelve?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: It's embarrassing! ...Hehe.

We have a great time exploring the
festival stalls
and attractions together.
Afterward...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That was fun! Everyone was so
enthusiastic as
always.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wasn't the butcher's stall amazing? I
wonder if
they were able to sell all of
the fried chicken
cakes after all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: By the way... you sure are carrying a lot.

She's not wrong. I received many
souvenirs from
the people of the
shopping district while we
walked
around.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Don't. Everyone likes you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Maybe they were nice to you before just
because
you're my trainer, but that's not
the case now.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
They just think you're a good person
now.
Probably.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, did you have fun today?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Really? You're not just saying that to
make me
feel better?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Because... I'm not a bright, fun-loving
girl.
choice_data_list: どうしてそう思うんだ？

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I can never say what I'm thinking
outright either. I
have to beat around
the bush, which probably
comes off as
annoying.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But even still, you keep me company
even outside
of training like this.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...I just hope it's not out of a sense of
obligation
or kindness.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I want you to spend time with me
because you
actually want to...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Seriously? For real?
choice_data_list: ネイチャといるのは楽しいよ

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Then... how important am I to you,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and don't say "third important." It's
not really
the time to make jokes.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I can't force you to answer that
question,
but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Siiiiigh...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
See, I'm such a pain, aren't I? I'm
regretting it
now, thinking I made you
say that.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But you're not totally innocent either.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It was you who said I could show even
my most
embarrassing side.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So... it's too late to say you regret
picking me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Cause I'll never let anyone steal my
number one
spot in your heart!
